checked_claims.notes: Existence of a Leray spectral sequence for the smooth DM forgetful morphism and the abutment degree filter p+q=28 for ordinary H^{28} are standard. The fiber identification as scheme-theoretic F(C,4) is only safe over locus of automorphism-free curves; at stacky points the fiber of the stack map is a configuration stack, so R^q f_* must be formed in the stack topos. Claim status 'proved' is therefore overstated, but the gap is not by itself a disproof of the Tate target.
checked_claims.statement: Forgetting the four ordered markings gives a Leray spectral sequence with fiber the ordered configuration space F(C,4), and any class relevant to the ordinary target has total degree 28.

checked_claims.notes: Two independent failures of the load-bearing identification. (1) Weight bookkeeping: V is pure of weight 1, so V^{\otimes4} is pure of weight 4; on the smooth stack M_7 the groups H^{24}(M_7,V^{\otimes4}) have weights at least 28, so the literal piece W_24 vanishes. Writing W_24 of a weight-4 coefficient system and then adding +4 again double-counts or silently reindexes V as a weight-0 local system. (2) Source geometry: H^1(C)^{\otimes4} lives in H^4(C^4), not automatically in R^4 f_*Q. Pairwise diagonals have complex codimension 1 in C^4, so restriction H^4(C^4)->H^4(F(C,4)) is not an isomorphism and Gysin/Kunneth shifts are mandatory. The 'only evident place' claim also fails to exhaust other bidegrees (p,q) with p+q=28 and mixed weights on nonproper configuration-space cohomology.
checked_claims.statement: The Kunneth term H^1(C)^{\otimes4} identifies W_24 H^24(M_7,V^{\otimes4}) in bidegree (24,4) as a possible source of total-degree-28, total-weight-28 non-Tate classes.

checked_claims.notes: No equivariant computation of R^4 f_*Q, no Gysin exact sequence for the diagonal stratification, and no invariants-versus-coinvariants analysis under monodromy or residual automorphisms. Survival of a nontrivial irreducible summand of V^{\otimes4} is entirely open.
checked_claims.statement: A nontrivial irreducible symplectic-local-system summand survives the diagonal relations into R^4f_*Q.

checked_claims.notes: No nonvanishing, no semisimplification-versus-actual-MHS comparison, and the weight index W_24 is itself suspect under standard VHS weight conventions. No non-Tate pure summand is exhibited.
checked_claims.statement: The relevant nontrivial summand has nonzero non-Tate W_24 H^24 on M_7.

checked_claims.notes: No differential analysis on the Leray page, no extension/cancellation control to the abutment, and no class in the exact Borel-Moore target. Poincare duality degree/twist match the packet (d=22, ordinary degree 28, BM degree 16, twists 22 and Tate types Q(-14)/Q(8)), but that only identifies the target group; it does not produce a non-Tate summand.
checked_claims.statement: A resulting class survives every Leray differential and defines a non-Tate summand of W_28 H^28(M_7,4)(22), equivalently W_-16 H^BM_16(M_7,4).

finding_candidates.statement: For the forgetful Leray analysis of ordinary weight-28 degree-28 cohomology on M_{g,n}, a pure summand of V^{\otimes n} has coefficient weight n; base cohomology H^p(M_g, L) then has weights at least p+n. Labeling a candidate source as W_p H^p(M_g,V^{\otimes n}) while also adding fiber weight n is an inconsistent weight convention and, under the standard VHS convention, the piece W_p vanishes.

Kunneth summands of H^*(C^n), including H^1(C)^{\otimes n}, are not automatically direct summands of R^*f_*Q for f:M_{g,n}->M_g. Pairwise diagonals have complex codimension 1, so passage to the ordered configuration space requires explicit Gysin/restriction sequences; without them, V^{\otimes n} is only a candidate before diagonal relations, not a coefficient system on M_g.

The ordered configuration fiber F(C,n) is nonproper, so R^q f_*Q carries mixed Hodge modules/variations. Non-Tate contributions to gr^W_{2d-16} H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n}) may sit in any Leray bidegree (p,q) with p+q=2d-16 compatible with the weight filtration; isolating a single slot such as (2d-16-n,n) does not exhaust possible non-Tate sources.

For the forgetful map of smooth DM stacks M_{g,n}->M_g, geometric fibers over curves with nontrivial automorphisms are configuration stacks rather than the scheme F(C,n). Claims that identify R^q f_*Q with the monodromy representation on H^q(F(C,n)) must either restrict to the automorphism-free locus and control the complement, or work entirely with stacky direct images.

A disproof of the degree-16 pure-Tate reduction for a listed open pair requires an exhibited nonzero non-Tate summand in the exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) (equivalently its ordinary realization after the dimension-dependent Poincare twist). A Leray-source heuristic with unproved survival, nonvanishing, and differentials does not meet that bar.

strongest_attack: The candidate E_2 slot W_24 H^{24}(M_7,V^{\otimes4})subseteq E_2^{24,4} is not correctly identified: with V pure of weight 1 the coefficient system V^{\otimes4} has weight 4, so H^{24}(M_7,V^{\otimes4}) has weights >=28 and the literal W_24 piece vanishes (or else the argument silently treats V as weight 0 and double-counts). Independently, the Kunneth summand of C^4 is not shown to survive the codimension-1 diagonal Gysin relations into R^4 f_*Q, and A3-A5 supply no nonvanishing, no differential survival, and no class in W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{7,4}). The attempt therefore neither refutes nor proves the Tate target and is incomplete.
